newsitem.title: USA: Freuhauf Trailer asset sale to Wabash cleared.
newsitem.headline: Freuhauf Trailer asset sale to Wabash cleared.

text.p: Fruehauf Trailer Corp. said Wednesday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware approved the previously announced sale of about $52 million worth of assets to Wabash National Corp.

Fruehauf said the assets included manufacturing facilities in Iowa and Tennessee, 31 retail outlets, an aftermarket parts distribution business in Grove City, Ohio, and all trademarks and patents, including the Fruehauf name.
The company said it expected to close the sale after receiving regulatory approvals.
